content: Give a man a fish and you feed him for a day; teach a man to fish and you feed him for a lifetime.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Shou ren yi yu, bu ru shou ren yi yu (授人以鱼不如授人以渔) — Huainanzi
explanation: Charity that creates endless dependency diminishes human dignity. The highest act of love and leadership is imparting autonomy, teaching skills, and fostering inner resilience so the person can stand sovereign and feed their own household.
practicalInsight: Instead of stepping in to fix a problem for a colleague or child today, patiently guide them through solving it themselves.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your relationships are you fostering unhealthy dependency instead of empowering authentic capability?
